description: What a national pension institution told us in writing, as published on our answers page, with the institution, the date of the reply and the link. The question is free text, matched to the questions we hold answers to.

country.description: A country: English or native name, alias or ISO code, for example NL or Netherlands.

language.description: Optional. Language of our own sentences, default en: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh, vi, uk, bg. Facts stay as stored.

question.description: The question in plain words, for example "What do heirs need?".
